dedupe_keys.name: lamasus simulated crop yields and nitrogen fertiliser rates for nine crops under six management intensity scenarios in the eu epic iiasa

description: Gridded simulated crop yields and the related nitrogen fertiliser application rates for nine crop types under six management intensity scenarios across the European Union. The Zenodo record says the data are part of the knowledge base on climate impacts of land-use management delivered as Deliverable D5.1 of the EU project LAMASUS, simulated with the EPIC-IIASA model, and that values are averages for 2001 to 2020 at 5 arc-minutes in NetCDF, with a ReadMe. It was published on 15 September 2025 by Juraj Balkovič of IIASA as a single downloadable ZIP of about 22 MB, free under CC BY 4.0. Coverage is the EU. Caveats: the nine crops and six scenarios are not named on the record read, values are 20-year averages with no year-to-year variation, and the results are modelled. For simulation it shows how yields and fertiliser demand change with management intensity, to test farm input supply chains and land-use scenarios. A related catalogue record is the FABIO food and agriculture biomass input-output tables.
